responsibility: Provides the compiler’s procedural-macro support for defining compact, strongly typed index newtypes used with `rustc_index` collections and other internal indexing APIs. Its root `lib.rs` exposes the public `newtype_index!` macro interface that other compiler crates invoke, while `newtype.rs` contains the macro implementation: it parses the macro input and customization options, then generates the index newtype along with the trait impls and helpers the compiler relies on, including conversions, bounds checking, `rustc_index::Idx` support, optional ordering/step behavior, serialization, and debug formatting. Together, the crate centralizes boilerplate-free generation of safe, efficient index types that support rustc’s internal data structures.
